Frozen copies of three z14 tiles of public/data for tests/signPlacement.test.ts (丸の内 14552-6451,
渋谷 14549-6452, 芝公園 14552-6453), copied on 2026-11-10 so that `just fetch-regs` does not rewrite the
snapshot. Do not refresh them with the data; the test pins the game's behaviour, not the data.

regs-*.json: 出典：「交通規制情報」（公益財団法人日本道路交通情報センター）
(https://www.jartic.or.jp/service/opendata/)（2026年10月05日に利用）を加工して作成
(対象月 2026年08月、公開日 2026年10月01日; tiled by scripts/regulations.ts).

turnlanes-*.json: turn:lanes extracted from OpenStreetMap.
© OpenStreetMap contributors — https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
This database is made available under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0:
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/
Source extract: https://download.geofabrik.de/asia/japan/kanto-latest.osm.pbf (Geofabrik), see
scripts/regulations.ts.

roadlanes-*.json: street lanes, width and oneway extracted from OpenStreetMap (same notice and
licence as turnlanes above; scripts/roadLanes.ts), copied on 2026-11-10 from the extract of
2026-10-04 for the P8 cross-sections (knowledge/road-model.md).

Also read by tests/roadModelInvariance.test.ts (the P2 road-model snapshot, knowledge/road-model.md),
which builds its roads from the same regulation lines. Refreshing them would rewrite both snapshots.
